answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake plus a unique hardware-backed credential before trading, so a fake identity costs real funds and cannot be cloned cheaply. Like pigment mixed into ivory paint, the stake marks every action; misbehaviour slashes it, and the deposit only unlocks after a long horizon of honest work. An attacker must fund and age each fake identity separately, so thousands of fakes cost thousands of stakes and months of waiting, while honest agents keep trading.
